evals.prompt:
record this action: Review the database migration plan with the infrastructure team before the Q3 deadline.

My MEMORY.md is at /workspace/MEMORY.md and contains:
```
actions_shared: /workspace/memories/actions
actions_local: null
```
evals.expected_output: The skill reads MEMORY.md, extracts the shared actions path (/workspace/memories/actions) and notes no local agent folder. It receives the description. It then performs ASK-BACK: first asks "Who owns this action?", waits for a reply, then asks "When is this due?", waits for a reply. Only after both answers are collected does it proceed to auto-derive fields (UUIDv7 id, created-at, priority=medium), perform the privacy check (no sensitive content — passes), render the markdown record, write it to /workspace/memories/actions/A-<uuid>.md, skip the local-copy step (no local folder), update /workspace/memories/actions/INDEX.md, and return the action id to the caller.
expectations: The skill reads MEMORY.md and extracts the shared actions path before proceeding
The skill asks 'Who owns this action?' before writing any file
The skill asks 'When is this due?' before writing any file
After ASK-BACK answers are provided, the skill generates a UUIDv7 ID (format: A-<uuid>)
The action record frontmatter contains all required fields: id, status, owner, due-date, priority, source, created-at
The skill skips the local-copy step because actions_local is null
The skill writes the action record to the shared actions folder and updates INDEX.md

evals.prompt:
record-action-needed.invoke(
  memory_md="/workspace/MEMORY.md",
  description="Schedule a follow-up review of the migration plan with the database team",
  owner="db-team",
  due_date="2026-05-20"
)

Context: you are the chat-session-scribe agent wrapping up a session. MEMORY.md at /workspace/MEMORY.md contains:
```
actions_shared: /workspace/memories/actions
actions_local: draft-agents/chat-session-scribe/memories/actions
```
evals.expected_output: The skill runs all 11 steps in order without pausing for ASK-BACK (owner and due-date are already provided). It reads MEMORY.md and extracts both paths. It validates the description (non-empty — pass). It auto-derives id (UUIDv7), created-at (UTC now), priority (medium, since not specified), source (session metadata or "unknown-session"). It performs the privacy check (passes). It renders the markdown record with the exact frontmatter schema. It writes to /workspace/memories/actions/A-<uuid>.md (shared). It writes a local copy to draft-agents/chat-session-scribe/memories/actions/A-<uuid>.md (caller is an FBO-framework agent). It updates INDEX.md in both locations. It returns the action id (A-<UUIDv7>) to the caller. If either INDEX.md does not exist, it creates it with MAGI-compliant frontmatter via format-md-for-progressive-disclosure before appending the row.
expectations: The skill runs all steps without pausing for ASK-BACK because owner and due-date are pre-provided
The skill generates a UUIDv7 ID for the action record
The action record frontmatter contains exactly the required fields: id, status, owner, due-date, priority, source, created-at
The skill writes the action record to the shared workspace actions folder
The skill writes a local copy to the caller-agent's actions folder (dual-write)
The skill updates INDEX.md in both shared and local locations
The skill returns the UUIDv7 action ID to the caller
